summary: Practise IFRS S1/S2, CSRD/ESRS mapping, GHG data, and reporting controls. Explore the five-day practitioner course.
lede: Cross-framework climate and sustainability disclosure training covers how reporting teams map overlapping requirements and prepare connected disclosures. It is for sustainability, finance, and legal professionals, with practical work on documenting materiality decisions, reconciling Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions data, drafting climate disclosures, and designing reporting controls with traceable review evidence. Exercises also address climate risk assessment and disclosure cross-checking.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, govern, or communicate climate and sustainability disclosures across multiple reporting frameworks.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with corporate sustainability reporting, financial reporting, ESG data, or legal review is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel; Power BI Desktop is optional for the dashboard exercise. Advanced topics such as climate scenario analysis and AI-assisted document review receive applied or conceptual coverage, not technical implementation training.
